latestVersion.changelog:
Known Issues with Official CPA Container
Practical use reveals these common problems:
•   Incorrect /root/.cli-proxy-api directory permissions, preventing OAuth file writes.
•   Read-only config mounts, blocking WebUI modifications.
•   Upgrade risks from format or structure changes between versions, risking data loss.
•   No safe update procedure, forcing manual backup, test, and rollback steps.
Solutions Provided by This Skill
✅ Fixes auth directory permissions automatically.
✅ Ensures writable config mounts for the WebUI.
✅ Standardizes the safe workflow: Backup → Test → Deploy → Rollback.
✅ Automates baseline checks and version verification.
